method: DEM flat-bottomed silo discharge through a circular orifice vs Beverloo
notes: github.com/MercuryDPM/MercuryDPM does not exist (HTTP 404; git clone asked for credentials); cloned the official Bitbucket repo instead. Library + one demo built with make -j2 in 185 s. Grains coarse-grained x4 (1.44-1.96 mm). Linear spring-dashpot, tc = 1 ms, dt = tc_min/25. First attempt (tc/50, 0.9 s) was stopped as too slow for the 8 min budget. Status 'partial' = ran at reduced scale (coarse-grained x4, 2500-3000 grains, sub-second discharge windows). D=10 mm (D/d 5.9) clogged; D=14 mm (D/d 8.2) flowed at 0.84 x Beverloo.
